name: slicethru
description: Beat Slice (Play Through): a ninth Play Mode, Beat Slice Thru, whose notes play from their slice to the end of the sample

branches.note: play-mode dispatcher 0x60032abc, Beat Slice case: bl 0x60032b50(voice, instrument, note) -> mt_bt_bs_note_on (the instrument's play-through flag for the call)
Beat Slice note-on: bl 0x60100694(end point, length, address) -> mt_bt_end_frames (the sample end 0xffff while playing through)
0x600f7c54: bl disp_ctrl_set_data(controls, Play Mode list, scr+0xb58) -> mt_bt_list_data (9 names, the instrument's row)
buttons 7/8 callback 0x600f5e1c: bl 0x600f5b98(+1) (8th button) -> mt_bt_button_plus (a step of the 9-row list)
buttons 7/8 callback 0x600f5e1c: bl 0x600f5b98(-1) (7th button) -> mt_bt_button_minus (a step of the 9-row list)

words.note: Sample Playback screen callback pool: encoder 0x600c92e1 -> mt_bt_encoder (Play Mode list focused: a step of the 9-row list)
Sample Playback screen callback pool: +1 0x600c9d85 -> mt_bt_plus (Play Mode list focused: one row down)
Sample Playback screen callback pool: -1 0x600ca7a5 -> mt_bt_minus (Play Mode list focused: one row up)
Sample Playback screen vtable: update method 0x600f6071 -> mt_bt_playback_update (slicethru.bin load/save; the list redrawn after a load)
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_bt_pattern_update (slicethru.bin load/save)
